smoke_params.model: front model: arrival by shortest walkable path / spread_speed, level ramps over ramp_s, ceiling 1 - d/reach_m

routing.note: route cost x (1 + alpha*s); dense cells impassable for planning; someone already inside dense smoke walks out at min_speed along the cheapest path

before.model: dynamic smoke-aware egress on a 0.5 m grid with staggered departures; the route field is recomputed every replan_s, smoky routes cost more and dense smoke is avoided; speed falls with smoke level; positions baked as USD time samples. Routing, throughput, timing and exposure only -- people do not collide, so NO density figure is derived or claimed from this run. Smoke is a simplified front model, not fire physics.
